articles.summary: Dozens of soccer fans displayed Iran’s pre-revolutionary Lion and Sun flag at the country’s World Cup opener. articles.title: Odesa's Property Boom Defies War As Buyers Return To Black Sea
articles.summary: Odesa's property market is experiencing a surge despite ongoing Russian strikes from the Black Sea. Real estate agents report that seaside homes and apartments are selling rapidly. Demand is primarily from local residents, buyers from Kyiv, and Ukrainians displaced by the conflict. Life in the city continues, with residents protected by air defense systems. articles.title: A turning point for Haiti? New security force takes fight to powerful gangs
articles.summary: Haiti's interim government deployed a new national police tactical unit to the capital. The unit, known as the Leopards, began operations against powerful gangs on 15 October. This marks a significant escalation in the government's efforts to regain control of Port-au-Prince. The Leopards unit is trained and equipped by the United States. articles.title: Resettlement remains out of reach for millions of refugees
articles.summary: The UN refugee agency called for an urgent expansion of resettlement programs. Millions of people are fleeing war or persecution. Available places fall short of global needs. UNHCR warned that resettlement remains out of reach for many. As millions of people continue to flee their countries due to war or persecution, UNHCR, the UN refugee agency, called on Tuesday for an urgent expansion of refugee resettlement programmes, warning that available places continue to fall short of global needs.

articles.title: Global fish production hits new high, but climate threats loom
articles.summary: Global fish production has reached a record high, with aquaculture supplying most of the fish consumed. However, rising temperatures and overfishing pose significant threats to the industry's future sustainability. Aquaculture now supplies most of the fish people eat, a landmark report by the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) reveals, but rising temperatures and overfishing are putting the future of the industry at risk.

articles.title: Trump Hints At Renewed Ukraine Focus, Iran In 'Rear-View Mirror'
articles.summary: Donald Trump met with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy at the G7 summit. Trump stated Russia should reach a deal regarding the conflict. He suggested the war in Ukraine might become a higher priority. Trump also indicated Iran was no longer a primary focus. US President Donald Trump held a “very good meeting” with his Ukrainian counterpart Volodymyr Zelenskyy at the G7 summit in France, adding that “Russia should make a deal” while hinting that Europe’s largest conflict since World War II might be moving up his priority list.

articles.title: South African jazz pianist Abdullah Ibrahim dies aged 91
articles.summary: South African jazz pianist and composer Abdullah Ibrahim has died at age 91. He passed away peacefully in Germany after a brief illness. Ibrahim recorded over 70 albums during his career. The accomplished musician, who recorded over 70 albums in his career, died peacefully in Germany after a short illnessThe South African jazz composer and pianist Abdullah Ibrahim has died at the age of 91. articles.title: मोदी-मेलोनी की मुलाकात, जयशंकर की स्माइल वायरल
articles.summary: G7 शिखर सम्मेलन में प्रधानमंत्री मोदी और इटली की प्रधानमंत्री मेलोनी की मुलाकात की तस्वीरें वायरल हुईं। विदेश मंत्री एस. जयशंकर भी इस दौरान मुस्कुराते हुए नजर आए। G7 शिखर सम्मेलन (G7 Summit) के दौरान प्रधानमंत्री मोदी और इटली की प्रधानमंत्री जॉर्जिया मेलोनी की मुलाकात और उनकी गर्मजोशी इंटरनेट पर वायरल हो गई। जयशंकर भी फ्रेम में चुपके से मुस्कुराते हुए नजर आए।

articles.title: फ्रांस की 'पनौती' जगह पर हुई डील, 107 साल पहले 8 करोड़ मौतों की पड़ी थी नींव, क्या ईरान-US की
articles.summary: फ्रांस के वर्साय पैलेस में अमेरिका-ईरान समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर हुए। फ्रांस के ऐतिहासिक वर्साय पैलेस में 107 साल बाद फिर एक बड़ी संधि पर हस्ताक्षर हुए हैं. अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप ने अमेरिका-ईरान समझौते पर यहां साइन किए. यही वह महल है जहां 1919 में प्रथम विश्व युद्ध खत्म करने वाली वर्साय संधि हुई थी. हालांकि दोनों समझौतों की मंशा और शर्तों में जमीन-आसमान का फर्क है.
